prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” AI video ad maker — the right choice depends on what you need (realistic AI presenters vs. fast social clips, level of customization, budget, languages, ad platforms). Below are top choices by common use-case so you can pick quickly.

Short summary recommendations
- Realistic AI presenter (talking head ads): Synthesia, HeyGen, Elai — best for on‑screen AI actors, many languages and natural TTS.
- Fast social ads & templates: Canva, InVideo (now often branded as InVideo/VEED overlap), VEED — easiest and fastest for storyboards, brand kits and vertical formats.
- Script/long-to-short repurposing: Pictory — good automated captioning, highlight extraction, and short-cut creation from long videos.
- Creative/generative visuals & advanced editing: Runway — strong for generative visual effects, creative video generation and fine editing.
- In-depth editing + overdub: Descript — excellent for editing by text, overdub voices and making corrections quickly.
- Data-driven ad production/optimization at scale: VidMob, Smartly.io (more ad ops + creative testing) — for high-volume, performance-driven ad campaigns.

Quick pros/cons (high level)
- Synthesia: + realistic multi-language avatars, quick script→video. − limited custom motion/scene complexity; can feel templated.
- HeyGen/Elai: + alternative avatar styles and pricing; similar strengths/limits to Synthesia.
- Canva: + huge template library, brand kit, extremely easy. − less advanced AI actor features.
- Pictory: + great for turning webinars/podcasts into ad clips automatically. − less control over fine visual style.
- Runway: + cutting-edge generative visuals, compositing and creative exploration. − steeper learning curve, more compute/price.
- Descript: + superb for editing, captions, and voice fixes. − not focused on creating AI actors or generative scenes.
- VidMob/Smartly: + analytics-driven creative testing and ad-scale production. − more of an enterprise/agency solution.

How to pick the best one for you
1. Define goal: platform (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube), ad length, vertical vs horizontal, realism level (live actor vs animated).  
2. Decide budget: free/trial, low monthly, or enterprise.  
3. Required features: AI presenter? Stock footage? Auto-captioning? Brand kit? Multi-language TTS?  
4. Output & integrations: upload formats, ad platform integrations, bulk exports.  
5. Test: use trials to create one ad and compare speed, quality, and workflow.

If you tell me: platform(s), ad style (talking head vs. animated vs. montage), budget, and whether you need bulk production or single ads, I’ll recommend the single best tool and a short workflow tailored to you.
